programme.title: Premier League 2024/25

programme.title: Premier League 2024/25

programme.title: Premier League 2024/25

programme.title: Premier League 2024/25

programme.title: Premier League 2024/25

programme.title: AL Rayyan (QAT) vs Al Ahli (KSA) - AFC Champions League Elite 2024/25 - West R16 1st Leg
programme.desc: This will be the second meeting between Al-Rayyan and Al-Ahli in the AFC Champions League, following their first group stage encounter this season which ended in a 2-1 win for Al-Ahli. Al-Rayyan have reached the Round of 16 in the AFC Champions League for the second time after 2022, while Al-Ahli have advanced to this stage for the ninth time in their history and the first since 2020. Al-Ahli have faced Qatari teams in the Round of 16 twice, advancing in 2013 against Al-Jaish and exiting in 2018 against Al-Sadd.

programme.title: Pakhtakor (UZB) vs Al Hilal (KSA) - AFC Champions League Elite 2024/25 - West R16 1st Leg
programme.desc: Pakhtakor have not won any of their eight matches against Al-Hilal in the AFC Champions League, including three home matches. They are one of 14 teams Pakhtakor have not beaten, but they have faced Al-Hilal the most. Pakhtakor have reached the knockout stages of the AFC Champions League for the sixth time and the first since 2020, making them the second most successful Uzbek team in this regard after Bunyodkor.

programme.title: Shanghai Port (CHN) vs Yokohama F. Marinos (JPN) - AFC Champions League Elite 2024/25 - East R16 1st
programme.desc: Shanghai Port have lost four consecutive meetings with Japanese teams in the AFC CL Elite, including a 2-0 defeat to Yokohama F.Marinos at home in the group stage this season. They have conceded multiple goals in each of the four matches. Shanghai Port have lost back-to-back AFC CL Elite matches, they only lost three consecutive such games in December 2020.

programme.title: Vissel Kobe (JPN) vs Gwangju (KOR) - AFC Champions League Elite 2024/25 - East R16 1st Leg
programme.desc: This will be just the second meeting between Vissel Kobe and Gwangju in the AFC Champions League Elite, after 2-0 win for Kobe in MD4 this season; Kobe lost their most recent encounter against South Korean sides, after winning two games, while Gwangju have lost only once in their three meetings with Japanese clubs in the competition, although it was against Kobe. Kobe have lost two of their last three games in the ACLE, conceding seven goals in total; they have not won any of their three meetings with South Korean clubs in the knockout stage in the competition, losing each of their last two.

programme.title: Shanghai Shenhua FC (CHN) vs Kawasaki Frontale (JPN) - AFC Champions League Elite 2024/25 - East R16
programme.desc: This is set to be the second meeting between Shanghai Shenhua and Kawasaki Frontale in the AFC CL Elite. Shenhua defeated Kawasaki Frontale 2-0 at home in the group stage this season. Kawasaki Frontale have won seven in the past nine encounters with Chinese opponents, having been winless in the previous six meetings. Shanghai Shenhua have scored in five consecutive home games in the AFC CL Elite, their joint-longest such streak in the competition.

programme.title: DTM Show 2025-Zandvoort
programme.desc: DTM. The embodiment of Motorsport tradition. Having just turned 40, the DTM combines a unique fascination and familiarity with an unmistakable dynamic, signified by the rebranding with a new logo! Seven different manufacturers – ten different winners on six brands (Audi, BMW, Mercedes, Lamborghini, Porsche and Ferrari) through twelve races are but one testament to the unique competitive balance that makes every DTM weekend a revelation! And with the addition of Ford, the palette of different brands is only increasing!

We look at the life and adaptation throughout Ramadan of Adam Azim – an unbeaten professional boxer from the UK, Fares El Bakh – a weightlifter who won Qatar’s first ever Olympic gold medal, and Zainab Alema – a rugby player who is aiming to become the first player to represent England wearing a hijab. programme.title: Everton vs Liverpool - English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Everton won 2-0 in their last Premier League game against Liverpool in April 2024, last winning consecutive league Merseyside derbies in the 1984-85 campaign. Liverpool’s 2-0 loss in this exact fixture last season ended a 12-game unbeaten away run in the Premier League against Everton. They’ve not lost consecutive visits to Goodison Park since a run of three between 1992 and 1994.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Crystal Palace- English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Man City have lost just one of their last 12 Premier League games against Crystal Palace, going down 2-0 at home in October 2021. Having lost each of their first six Premier League visits to the Etihad Stadium, Crystal Palace have lost just two of their last six away to Man City in the competition.

Villarreal / FC Barcelona
programme.desc: Only three days after having undergone the first defeat of the Hansi Flick era against AS Monaco (2-1) in the Champions League, FC Barcelona finds La Liga with the ambition to consolidate its leader's chair on the lawn of Villarreal, 4th, still undefeated this season with 3 victories and 2 draws on the clock. Guided by a Lamine Yamal still exceptional at only 17 years old with already 3 goals and 4 assists since the start of the season, a Robert Lewandowski Surgical in the last gesture, top scorer in Liga with 4 achievements, or even a jules Koundé infranchopable in his right corridor, the Catalans have all the ingredients to win a 6th consecutive victory and keep their invincibility on the national scene against the national scene against the national scene against the national scene against the national scene against the national scene against The yellow submarine that counts on the legendary vista, Dani Parejo, the ultra-precise centers of Alex Baena or the cold blood of the former goalscorer of Newcastle, Ayoze Perez, already 3 goals on the clock, to vibrate the 24,000 SP ...

programme.title: Spain / England
programme.desc: A European summit with a taste of finals. programme.title: Tours / Poitiers
programme.desc: Last act, last breath: the TVB is about to live an evening with a history on Saturday in Grenon, against Poitiers. Winner at the first leg (3-1), Tours has a golden opportunity to win a 10th title of champion of France, which would propel him at the height of AS Cannes at the top of the hexagonal volleyball. But a derby does not obey any logic. Poitiers, heckled but far from being killed, knows that it would be a victory, four daring sets, to write his own legend. The feat of Nantes last year, who came to impose themselves in the gold set, feeds their hopes. The Alterna will count on Nik Mujanovic, in search of a last shine under the pepper colors before joining the TVB this summer. At the end of the road: Europe and the Champions League. But for Tours, it is also the culmination of a forged season in the fight. From Luca Ramon to Ryan Sclater, all want to write the perfect epilogue under the leadership of Marcelo Fronckowiak and engrave their name in the marble of Grenon.

programme.title: Florida Panthers / Edmonton Oilers
programme.desc: Night of truth in Sunrise. Back to the amendment Bank Arena with a title ball in hand, Florida only needs a success to keep his Stanley Cup, the second in a row. Untouchables in regulation time since the start of the series, the Panthers have the opportunity to write history in front of their audience. But Edmonton did not say his last word. Beaten by these same panthers in the final last year, the Oilers no longer have the right to make mistakes. Led by a Pressure Connor McDavid, dumb in the last match but already the author of 6 assists in this series, the Canadians will play the excessive attack to snatch a saving game 7. In this battle for survival or glory, every detail will count. Florida wants to conclude, Edmonton wants to survive. An offensive explosion is to be expected, carried by the stars of an evening or a season. The match of all possibilities.

programme.title: Bath / Lyon
programme.desc: Two years after their triumph in Marseille, the Lyonnais find a CUP challenge final with the ambition to enrich their European list. Faced with them, a heavyweight of English rugby: Bath, the current leader of Premières, which aims a resounding double CUP Challenge - Premiership. The Lou advances with serious arguments. Davit Niniashvili, a X factor capable of blowing up any defense, a Bendeu hinge-Couilloud perfectly oiled, a Camille Cat back as heel holder, without forgetting a second Guillard line-William Impressive in the semi-finals against Racing 92. Despite a sawtooth season, the Rhodanians seem ready to strike a big blow to Cardiff. But Bath arrives launched. With the duo Charlie Ewels - Quinn Roux in spearhead of the pack, the Vista of Captain Ben Spencer at the melee and the magic of Finn Russell at the opening, the English intend to conclude their formidable season with a continental title. Duel of styles in sight, with a Euro trophy ...
